benefit: Avoids front-face R56/R57/R58/R59/R69/FB2 body and courtyard repacking. Opposing Hub bodies are not on this external carrier face.
geometry_scope: Track intersections use native integer endpoints and widths with buffered Shapely segments/circles. No full saved-fill clearance, refill, new lands, native DRC or routed candidate. No PTH pad bounding-box intersections found at either proposed foot.
span_crossings: Existing B.Cu 3V3, 5VSB, MAIN, SYS and signal copper crosses the raised span; it must not be treated as same-layer PCB bridging. Guaranteed minimum installed underside and maximum solder/via protrusion are required.

height_evidence.contract_scope: 22 mm interboard gap plus inward bodies and mating insertion; no qualified outer underside terminal-pin/solder envelope. Hardware screw head is 2.0 mm, itself below bar nominal 2.3 mm.
height_evidence.conclusion: Cannot establish Z neutrality. Native THT pads/model references do not establish installed exposed lead/solder length. Bar may create a new external underside limit.

process: Current native board has no B.Cu components. Backside SMT bar creates a new second-side attachment/inspection operation; retention during other reflow or selective/manual attach, access, solder acceptance and consignment availability require assembler confirmation. No process approval implied.
decision: Useful alternate front-face-avoidance geometry, but not drop-in: clear the named land copper, establish actual B.Cu 12V access/current and external Z/process evidence before adopting it. Source unchanged.
